current.text: He is projected to start at shooting guard in the same starting five as last season, with Cunningham, Thompson, Collins and Duren.
His starting spot looks safe, but he may be a half starter who plays only about 24 to 25 minutes.
Detroit used a deep 12 to 13 player rotation last season, which limited everyone's minutes.
He is not a draft target. The expert calls him a streaming option for threes, worth drafting only in 20-team leagues, with an ADP around 239 about right.
Detroit plays 4-3-4 games in our playoff weeks (season ending March 28). It has 15 back-to-backs, and no rest risks are expected.

durable.text: He is an elite three-point shooter.
His usage is low, and he adds little besides threes.
His defense and passing have improved a lot.
He takes very few free throws, so his FT% swings from year to year but barely moves a team's FT%.
